cohort: 7,438 neonates admitted to the CHU de Québec NICU (capacity of 51 beds) from April 10, 2008, to March 28, 2013
finding: Diagnosis-related group level, regular hours of work, overtime, admission rates, birth weight, and occupation rates were the main predictors for both nosocomial infections and medical accidents in the NICU.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery (C-section) was a poor predictor of nosocomial infections and medical accidents.
